diff --git a/debian/tests/run-ocft b/debian/tests/run-ocft
index f820fce..a90196c 100755
--- a/debian/tests/run-ocft
+++ b/debian/tests/run-ocft
@@ -2,8 +2,33 @@
 
 set -e
 
+setup_iscsi () {
+  modprobe iscsi_target_mod && return 0
+  if ! test -x /tmp/autopkgtest-reboot; then
+    echo "iSCSI setup requires autopkgtest reboot support" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+  # skip if kernel setup was already done and we are at the reboot
+  if test "${AUTOPKGTEST_REBOOT_MARK:-}" = generic-kernel; then
+    echo "Generic kernel was not booted after reboot" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+  if bash "$(dirname "$0")/setup_kernel"; then
+    /tmp/autopkgtest-reboot generic-kernel
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
 AGENT=$1
 
+# iscsi test needs iscsi_target_mod kernel module that might not be available
+# in the current kernel
+case "$AGENT" in
+  iscsi)
+    setup_iscsi 2>&1 || echo "Warning: iSCSI setup failed; continuing with the current kernel"
+    ;;
+esac
+
 cleanup () {
   ocft clean $AGENT
 }
diff --git a/debian/tests/setup_kernel b/debian/tests/setup_kernel
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..0bdd2c5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/setup_kernel
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+
+is_non_generic_kernel () {
+  case "$(uname -r)" in
+    *-generic) return 1 ;;
+    *) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+}
+
+# grub: switch to kernel version
+grub_switch_kernel() {
+    KERNELVER=$1
+    MID=$(awk '/Advanced options for Ubuntu/{print $(NF-1)}' /boot/grub/grub.cfg | cut -d\' -f2)
+    KID=$(awk "/with Linux $KERNELVER/"'{print $(NF-1)}' /boot/grub/grub.cfg | cut -d\' -f2 | head -n1)
+    cat > /etc/default/grub.d/99-ocft-tests-kernel.cfg <<EOF
+GRUB_DEFAULT=saved
+GRUB_SAVEDEFAULT=true
+EOF
+    grub-editenv /boot/grub/grubenv set saved_entry="${MID}>${KID}"
+    update-grub
+}
+
+setup_kernel () {
+  # skip if not ubuntu
+  ( . /etc/os-release; test "$ID" = ubuntu ) || return 2
+  is_non_generic_kernel || return 2
+
+  apt-get update || return 1
+  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y linux-generic || return 1
+  kernel_image=$(find -L /boot -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'vmlinuz-*-generic' -printf '%f\n' |
+    sort -V | tail -n 1)
+  if test -z "$kernel_image"; then
+    echo "No generic kernel image found in /boot" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+  kernel_version=${kernel_image#vmlinuz-}
+
+  grub_switch_kernel "$kernel_version" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+setup_kernel
